desc: The THUNDER CHICKEN by Q is the Quickie Fast-Attach version of the 100% titanium FULL NELSON. Equally quiet, durable and accurate, the THUNDER CHICKEN is the perfect solution for shooters with multiple silencer hosts. Like all Quickie silencers by Q, this one comes with both 1/2-28 and 5/8-24 Cherry Bomb muzzle brakes in the box.
